features.title: FastAPI/React skeleton with install instructions and tests
acceptance: Backend FastAPI app starts and responds to /health
Frontend Vite/React app builds and serves
Docker compose brings up backend + frontend + Keycloak
pytest and vitest run without errors

features.title: Plugin/skill catalog with search and detail view
acceptance: Backend stores plugins and skills in SQLite
Frontend displays searchable catalog with detail view
At least 3 workflows: browse, search, import from reference URL

features.title: GitHub issue ingestion and triage workflow
acceptance: Backend fetches and stores issues from reference repo
Frontend shows issue list with filtering by plugin/label

features.title: Content quality analysis engine (Chinese anti-slop detection)
acceptance: Deterministic offline analyzer for Chinese AI patterns
API endpoint returns structured quality report
Frontend workflow: paste text -> get quality score + suggestions
